text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-women panel is not evidence of anything on its own. Panels skew by sector, and in policy roles women are often well represented at that level. Composition tells you nothing about how the two of you scored.

What is actually off is the silence. Two weeks without a written explanation, when you've requested one, is the concrete, defensible complaint. Chase it in writing, cite any applicable timeframe, and ask for the scoring against the published criteria.

If you lead with the panel's sex, you'll look aggrieved rather than diligent, and you'll lose the credibility you need if the scores do turn out to be irregular. Get the documents first, then judge.
